headline: A 2018 law renamed a New Jersey post office building in Belleville after Private Henry Svehla.
what_it_does: This law names the U.S. Postal Service building at 413 Washington Avenue in Belleville, New Jersey, the "Private Henry Svehla Post Office Building." It is a naming measure only. It does not change how the post office operates, its services, or its rules.
when_it_takes_effect: It took effect when it was enacted on December 14, 2018.
